call_points.text: Q4 EBITDA margin was 11.2%, down from the record Q3; management gave no specific reason.
About ₹25 Cr capex over two years for labs serving existing clients, excluding any large new deal.
A digital AI lab in Chennai is to be set up in the next couple of months.
Revenue per employee is about ₹22 lakh, against ₹8-9 lakh four years ago.
Asked for constant-currency growth, management deferred to its IR manager E&Y instead of giving a figure.
Management said AI tools such as Claude have not affected engineering services so far and it is not billing AI-assisted work.
Management aims to drive sustained double-digit growth in Revenue and EBITDA for FY27.

Revenue is 88-90% time-and-material and the balance fixed-price; mechanical engineering is about 50% of revenue and software the other 50%.
About 70% of revenue comes from North America and 30% from Europe, with no India clients; about 125 employees sit outside India, planned to rise to 200-300.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹137.12 Cr (+7.7% YoY), net profit ₹9.55 Cr (-8.3% YoY).
Onward Technologies Limited’s Board, led by **Aakash Joshi**, recommended a final dividend of ₹8 per equity share for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval on May 5, 2026.
Onward Technologies reported FY26 revenue of ₹550.9 Cr (+10.5% YoY) and record EBITDA of ₹71.9 Cr (+60.9% YoY), recommending a ₹8 dividend.
Onward Technologies Limited uploaded the audio recording of its May 5, 2026 conference call on its website after announcing Q4FY26 and FY26 results, signed by Aakash Pankaj Joshi.

Onward Technologies' May 5, 2026 Q4FY26 call transcript: management reiterated double-digit FY27 revenue and EBITDA growth, called FY26's 13.2% EBITDA margin sustainable, and said a buyback is under board consideration.
Onward Technologies approved a ₹18 Cr share buyback at ₹328 per share through the tender offer route.
Onward Technologies published the public announcement for its ₹18 Cr buyback of 5,48,780 shares at ₹328 each (2.41% of capital), record date May 18, 2026, with promoters not participating.
Onward Technologies received an order from SEEPZ-SEZ imposing a ₹0.10 crore penalty for procedural SOFTEX filing delays, which was condoned.
Jigar Mehta, as Promoter of Onward Technologies Limited, declared no encumbrance on company shares held by Promoters/PACs for FY2026 on April 06, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹170.18 Cr (+22.5% YoY), net profit ₹16.77 Cr (+40.5% YoY).
Onward Technologies Limited uploaded the audio recording of its October 16, 2026 conference call on its website after announcing Q1&HYFY26 results, signed by Aakash Pankaj Joshi.
